# Adventure Quest Game Design

## Game Overview

Adventure Quest is a simple text-based adventure game where players navigate through a fantasy world, complete quests, and battle monsters. The game is designed to be easy to play and fun, with a simple text-based interface.

## Core Mechanics

### Player Movement

* The player can move in four directions: north, south, east, and west.
* The player's current location will be displayed at the top of the screen.
* The player's movement will be restricted to a grid-based world.

### Quest System

* Players will be given quests by non-playable characters (NPCs) in the game world.
* Quests will have rewards and penalties associated with them.
* Players will be able to accept and decline quests.
* Quests will have a status indicator to show progress.

### Combat System

* The player will encounter monsters in the game world.
* Combat will be turn-based.
* The player will be able to attack or run from monsters.
* Monsters will have health points (HP) and attack points (AP).
* The player will have HP and AP as well.
